country:
If null, check if exchange is null.
If exchange is not null,
    Check exchange against cis_security.exchange
    country = cis_security.country where exchange = cis_security.exchange
market_price:
Using isin = cis_equity_price.isin, check if cis_equity_price.main_closing_price is null for cis_equity_price.price_date = reporting_date.
If main_closing_price is not null for cis_equity_price.price_date = reporting_date,
    Take cis_equity_price.main_closing_price
Else if main_closing_price is null for cis_equity_price.price_date = reporting_date,
    cis_equity_price.main_closing_price = market_price
market_value_fc: If null, market_value_fc = quantity * (cis_equity_price.main_closing_price where isin = cis_equity_price.isin)
net_book_value_fc:
if net_book_value_fc is null,
    net_book_value_fc = cost_fc - provision_fc

Security: If fail, check security_full_name against cis_security.security_description
country: If exchange is null, entry fails
shares_issued:
If null, check if pct_holding and quantity are null.
    If pct_holding and quantity are not null,
        shares_issued = quantity / pct_holding

Security: If still fail, check security_short_name against security_name
Quantity: If cost_fc is null, entry fails
shares_issued: If shares_issued, pct_holding are null, entry fails

Security:
If still fail, 
    Check security_full_name against gmp_cis.cis_party.party_full_name
    If fail, check security_short_name against gmp_cis.cis_party.party_short_name
    If still fail, create new party with all relevant fields. Then create new security with issuer as party_short_name and all other relevant fields
